title: KANA-GP Organizational Rituals: Conceptual Model for Public Legitimacy and Symbolic Governance
description: Research package associated with an academic reflection article on organizational rituals, public legitimacy, symbolic governance and the KANA-GP conceptual model in Latin American public management. The package includes an anonymized manuscript source, conceptual figures, conceptual tables, editorial checklist and methodological transparency notes. It does not include empirical datasets.
